svg.aria-label: The 10c-dev build cycle. A Slack thread or client message is drafted into a ticket, which moves to In Progress. The project model is read, then Build holds the rung (R0 probe to R3 hardened), the interview, the spec, tests first from a separate agent, and writing the code. Verify runs it on the live app and fails back into step five. A code review agent reads the diff, then cleanup runs, then a critic with an empty context drives the running app: mandatory on risky changes or near a core capability, FAIL returns to step five. Commit and push happens only on your yes, to main or as a pull request. CI unit tests gate staging, where the ticket becomes In Review; CI e2e tests gate production; a human check there reaches Done, and a bug opens a new ticket. Parallel sessions see each other through a shared board.
svg.title: The 10c-dev build cycle
